title: Embedded Flow Canvas dist extractions accumulate forever — already 91 copies / 49 MB on this machine
existing_state: FlowCanvasDistLocator extracts the embedded React bundle to a per-BuildTimestamp directory under flow-canvas-dist in AppData (Utilities/FlowCanvasDistLocator.cs:114-119) — a fresh directory for every distinct build — and nothing anywhere deletes prior version directories. Verified live: this machine currently holds 91 timestamped directories totaling 49 MB, growing ~0.5 MB per build/release; since the app self-updates via GitHub releases, end users accumulate one copy per update indefinitely. The same pattern exists for scintilla-native per packageVersion (Utilities/ScintillaNativeBootstrap.cs:61-72; 2.3 MB here, slower-growing). Additionally, extraction skips any file that already exists without size/integrity check (FlowCanvasDistLocator.cs:136-137, ScintillaNativeBootstrap.cs:115-118), so a partially-written file from a crashed first extraction is trusted forever.
recommendation: After a successful extraction in ExtractEmbeddedDistToAppData, enumerate sibling directories under flow-canvas-dist and best-effort Directory.Delete(recursive:true) every one except the current version segment (swallow IOException for dirs locked by a concurrent instance). Apply the same sweep to scintilla-native. While there, replace the bare File.Exists skip with a length comparison against the resource stream so truncated extractions self-heal.
user_benefit: Stops silent unbounded AppData growth on every release for every user (already ~50 MB on the dev machine) and removes the corrupt-canvas-until-AppData-is-manually-deleted failure mode from interrupted extractions.
